Lindsay Clancy Case: Retrial Status Undecided After Mistrial

A retrial for Lindsay Clancy remains undecided following the first court appearance since a mistrial was declared. Clancy's motion for a finding of not guilty was denied weeks after the initial mistrial. The specific status of the retrial is still pending.
